Name: Cats obelisk
Author: RistaXcorpsekitty
Description:
[code]
🐾 Cats Obelisk — Aesthetic Retexture Overhaul

Transform your farm's end-game structures into a cozy, feline paradise! Cats Obelisk is a complete visual overhaul for all four major obelisks in Stardew Valley, featuring unique custom pixel art.


✨ Key Features


Cat-Themed Designs: Full pixel art replacement for the Earth, Water, Desert, and Island obelisks. Cozy Aesthetic: Beautifully detailed retextures that turn cold stone monuments into cute cat-themed landmarks. Vanilla Friendly: Carefully designed to blend seamlessly with the original Stardew Valley visual style. 1.6+ Optimized: Fully updated and built natively using the latest Content Patcher standards.

🛠 Requirements

To run this mod, you will need the latest versions of:
1. SMAPI
2. Content Patcher


💾 Installation

1. Download and install SMAPI and Content Patcher if you haven't already.
2. Download this mod and extract the ZIP file.
3. Place the folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.
4. Run the game using SMAPI!


💬 Permissions & Credits


Author: Rista Please do not reupload this mod to other platforms without my permission. Feel free to leave a comment or report any visual bugs in the posts section.
Thank you for downloading and enjoy your cozy new cat landmarks! 🐱[/code]
